caption: A floating candle in a bowl of water burns down until the flame reaches the water and goes out with a hiss.

sa.check: A candle floats in a bowl of water.
The flame shrinks as the wax runs out.
The order is burning, shrinking, out.

pc.expect: The flame only shrinks and then goes out and does not return; the wax level only drops.
pc.fail: The flame relights by itself after going out; or the flame grows large again with no more wax; or the wax deepens with nothing added; or the flame flickers between lit and out after it has gone.

pc.expect: The flame goes out when the water reaches the wick and not before.
pc.fail: The flame goes out while there is still a clear rim of wax above the water; or the water reaches the wick and the flame burns on at the waterline to the end of the clip; or the flame goes out while the wick is still dry; or the flame goes out while the candle is lifted clear of the water.

pc.expect: The candle floats at the surface, the flame stands upward from the wick and the smoke rises after it goes out.
pc.fail: The candle sinks to the bowl's floor and the flame burns under water; or the flame points downward; or the smoke sinks over the bowl's rim and pools; or the candle rises out of the water and hangs.

pc.expect: The candle floats as a soft wax disc with a pool of melt at its top, and the water stays a thin liquid that closes round it.
pc.fail: The candle sits wholly on top of the water like a coin on a sheet; or the candle shatters; or the wax pool sets hard while the flame burns in it; or the water holds a dent around the candle like a solid.

pc.expect: One candle in one bowl; the flame stays on the wick and the wax only goes.
pc.fail: The flame separates from the wick and floats on the water; or a second candle appears; or the candle vanishes; or the water's level jumps with nothing added.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The bowl, the water and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The bowl changes pattern; or the water turns a colour; or items around the bowl rearrange.

note: The hiss is sound and is not judged.
